metadata_source: saved read-only asset inventory; hashes not remeasured by this tool
native_policy: Reject empty, odd-byte, over32MiB or non-audio-root RAW; do not pad/drop samples. This is not recovered original malformed-input behavior.

raw_duration_audit.metadata_source: saved inventory byte lengths and statically recovered PCM_S16LE mono44100 descriptor; no current RAW reads
raw_duration_audit.incomplete_frame_note: Odd lengths have nominal byte-derived durations only, not playable complete-frame durations; native rejects them without padding or truncation.
raw_duration_audit.non_audio_grid_note: The 24 non-audio RAW selection grids are excluded; no PCM interpretation.

native_duration_policy.significance: Independent native decoder/cache limits, not canonical original asset constraints. Both thresholds are compared to every audio resource; paths do not prove loop/FX assignment.

remaining_unknowns: Original malformed odd-byte DirectSound acceptance/failure behavior was not exercised.
Original exact asset-selection/spatial sound gain/pitch semantics are outside this fixed-format recovery.
Zone musicNN.raw/soundNN.raw select resources and must never be PCM-decoded.

ogg_duration_audit.metadata_source: actual read-only ffprobe of installation files; no decoding or playback
ogg_duration_audit.encoded_bytes_source: actual installation file stat; inventory_bytes are saved lengths, neither rehashes

decoded_byte_estimate.status: estimate from reported container duration, not measured decoded length
